sources.title: owj0421/outfit-transformer | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides a comprehensive overview of the Outfit Transformer repository, a fashion recommendation system that implements and enhances the "Outfit Transformer" model from CVPR 2023. The system performs two primary tasks: compatibility prediction (CP) between fashion items and complementary item retrieval (CIR) for outfit completion.
